content: Deputy review sentiment: aggregator sites Capterra and G2 show high scores around 4.5 to 4.6, but independent review sites such as Trustpilot rate meaningfully lower around 3.9, with recurring complaints about support responsiveness, offshored support, and pricing complexity rather than the qualifications feature itself, meaning qualifications and skills matching is not a top complaint driver; onboarding, support and pricing are. When I Work vs Deputy: Deputy edges ahead on ease of setup and administration.
